items.text: Janet Jackson's "Miss You Much" spent four weeks at number one on the Billboard Hot 100, one of the two longest-running number-one singles of 1989.
items.question: Where were you living when Janet Jackson's "Miss You Much" was on the radio, and who in your life knew the dance?
items.source_quote: These are the Billboard Hot 100 number-one singles of 1989. The two longest running number-one singles of 1989 are "Miss You Much" by Janet Jackson and "Another Day in Paradise" by Phil Collins, which each charted at number one for four weeks.

items.text: Nintendo's Game Boy was released in North America on July 31, 1989.
items.question: Who was the first person you knew to own a Game Boy, and which game did they play on it?
items.source_quote: July 31 – Nintendo's Game Boy is released in North America.

items.text: The Simpsons premiered on Fox on December 17, 1989, with the episode "Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire".
items.question: Who did you watch The Simpsons with when it first came on, and which character reminded you of someone you knew?
items.source_quote: December 17 – The television show The Simpsons premiered on FOX with the episode "Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire".

items.text: The Berlin Wall was brought down on November 9, 1989.
items.question: Where were you when you heard the Berlin Wall had come down, and who told you?
items.source_quote: November 9 – The Berlin Wall is brought down.
